**Step 1 of 9 — Take a reference photo first**

Before touching anything, get a close-up shot of the existing phone block — the black board with the rows of small coloured slots. You want all the wire colours clearly visible. This is just your "before" record in case you need to undo anything.

**Don't touch yet:**
- The coax splitter and silver coax fittings at the top
- The yellow-green ground wire at the bottom

When you've got a clear close-up, send it over and I'll check it! 📷
